title: The Firework-Maker’s Daughter
text: The finale’s firework competition is more extravagantly breathtaking in ways I won’t spoil. There’s excellent puppetry from hulking Hamlet – controlled by two cast members within – to intricate shadow puppets parading across a lampshade. When red lights, smoke, crackling sound effects and a rumbling voiceover conjure the fire fiend, a spooked Artie suggests raising the minimum age guidance to nine.
